user_input: What is the HR leave policy?
retrieved_contexts:
['question: Can I carry forward unused leave to next year?
answer: Up to 5 unused leave days can be carried forward into the next calendar year.
department: HR
date: 2026-01-15', '# Employee Onboarding Guide

Welcome to the company. This page covers the essentials for your first two weeks.

## IT Setup

New employees receive a laptop and access credentials on Day 1. IT Support is available through the internal ticketing system. Standard laptop requests are fulfilled within 2 business days. VPN access is required for all employees working remotely more than two days per week.

## Leave Policy

Employees accrue 1.5 days of paid leave per month, capped at 18 days per year. Leave requests must be submitted through the HR portal at least 3 business days in advance for planned leave. Sick leave does not require advance notice but must be reported to your manager on the same day.

## Expense Reimbursement

All expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date. Claims above INR 5,000 require manager approval before submission. The Finance department processes approved claims within 10 business days.

## Remote Work Policy

Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval. Fully remote arrangements require Director-level sign-off and are reviewed quarterly. All remote employees must be reachable during core hours (10 AM to 4 PM local time).

## Performance Reviews

Performance reviews are conducted twice a year, in April and October. Self-assessments are due one week before the review cycle opens. Ratings are calibrated across each department by the department head before being finalized.
', '# Benefits Overview

## Health Insurance
All full-time employees are covered under the group health insurance plan from
day one of employment. Coverage extends to spouse, children, and dependent
parents. The sum insured is INR 5,00,000 per family per year.

## Provident Fund (PF)
Employees contribute 12% of basic salary to PF, matched by the company. PF
withdrawals are allowed after 2 months of continuous unemployment or for
specific reasons like home purchase or medical emergencies, per government rules.

## Gratuity
Employees who complete 5 or more years of continuous service are eligible for
gratuity as per the Payment of Gratuity Act.

## Wellness Allowance
Every employee gets an annual wellness allowance of INR 10,000, reimbursable
against gym memberships, fitness classes, or mental health counseling sessions.
']
response: The HR leave policy states that employees accrue paid leave at a rate of 1.5 days per month, with a maximum cap of 18 days per calendar year. Planned leave must be requested through the HR portal at least 3 business days in advance, while sick leave does not require advance notice but must be reported to a manager on the same day. Additionally, up to 5 unused leave days can be carried forward into the next calendar year.
reference: Employees accrue 1.5 days of paid leave per month, capped at 18 days per year. Planned leave requires 3 business days advance notice through the HR portal. Sick leave does not require advance notice but must be reported the same day. Up to 5 unused leave days can be carried forward to the next year.

are generally eligible for hybrid arrangements. Client-facing roles require manager approval on a
case-by-case basis. All remote work arrangements are reviewed annually during performance cycles.
